mistakes.text: Her speech was rewrote twice before she ever walked onto that stage.
mistakes.normalized: her speech was rewrote twice before she ever walked onto that stage
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Passive patrí za „was“ past participle: „rewritten“, nie „rewrote“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V Passive patří za „was“ past participle: „rewritten“, ne „rewrote“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Passive needs the past participle after “was”: “rewritten”, not “rewrote”.

mistakes.text: Her speech rewrote twice before she ever walked onto that stage.
mistakes.normalized: her speech rewrote twice before she ever walked onto that stage
mistakes.feedback_sk: Prejav sa sám neprepisuje, preto treba Passive: „was rewritten“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Projev se sám nepřepisuje, proto je potřeba Passive: „was rewritten“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The speech didn't rewrite anything, so use the Passive: “was rewritten”.

mistakes.text: Her speech is rewritten twice before she ever walked onto that stage.
mistakes.normalized: her speech is rewritten twice before she ever walked onto that stage
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej sa odohral v minulosti, preto „was rewritten“, nie „is rewritten“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj proběhl v minulosti, proto „was rewritten“, ne „is rewritten“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The action happened in the past, so use “was rewritten”, not “is rewritten”.

mistakes.text: Someone rewrote her speech twice before she ever walked onto that stage.
mistakes.normalized: someone rewrote her speech twice before she ever walked onto that stage
mistakes.feedback_sk: Cvičenie precvičuje Passive: podmetom je prejav, teda „her speech was rewritten“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Cvičení procvičuje Passive: podmětem je projev, tedy „her speech was rewritten“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Passive: “her speech was rewritten”.

mistakes.text: They rewrote her speech twice before she ever walked onto that stage.
mistakes.normalized: they rewrote her speech twice before she ever walked onto that stage
mistakes.feedback_sk: Cvičenie precvičuje Passive: podmetom je prejav, teda „her speech was rewritten“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Cvičení procvičuje Passive: podmětem je projev, tedy „her speech was rewritten“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Passive: “her speech was rewritten”.

mistakes.text: Her speech was rewritten twice before she ever walked onto that podium.
mistakes.normalized: her speech was rewritten twice before she ever walked onto that podium
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pódium, na ktoré sa vychádza, je prirodzenejšie „stage“; „podium“ je malý stupienok.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pódium, na které se vychází, je přirozenější „stage“; „podium“ je malý stupínek.
mistakes.feedback_en: A platform you walk onto is a “stage”; a “podium” is a small raised stand.
